PreCommit.command: cd backend && (command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1 && golangci-lint run ./... || echo 'golangci-lint not installed, skipping') && (go vet ./... 2>/dev/null || true)
cd frontend && ([ -f node_modules/.bin/eslint ] && npm run lint || echo 'eslint not configured, skipping')

PrePush.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) && if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo 'ERROR: Direct push to main is not allowed. Create a PR instead.' && exit 1; fi
PrePush.description: Block direct push to main branch

PrePush.command: cd backend && go test ./... 2>/dev/null || echo 'No Go tests found, skipping'
cd frontend && ([ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"test"' package.json && npm test || echo 'No frontend tests configured, skipping')
